Author: Blackcatz1911, dajoey
Name: Lazy Currency Spender
Description: Fork of CurrencySpender by Blackcatz1911. Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Punchline: Find the absolute best way to spend all your FFXIV currencies.
Changelog:
v1.3.1.8 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The windows were polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The main, settings, spending-guide, debug and setup windows share one look: a header bar with brand, status and window buttons, a navigation band, a page title block and a status footer.
- Currency balances and spending-guide tables use fixed, right-aligned number columns and framed Flag, TP and Spend it buttons; long names are shortened with the full name on hover.
- In narrow windows the tables keep their sideways scroll and a readable name column, so every button stays reachable.
- The settings window gains a framed Minimum sales field and a full-width separator list, and the instructions use numbered step cards.

v1.3.1.7 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The plugin windows now use responsive card-based layouts with custom close and minimize controls in place of the native title bars, clear currency state indicators, and scrollable settings, wizard and table content. Currency calculations, spending behavior and saved configuration are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.3.1.6 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The main and debug windows now register under their own window IDs (Windows/MainTabWindow.cs and Windows/DebugTabWindow.cs constructors): since 1.3.1.5 both were created with a blank internal window ID, so on every launch the second registration threw and the plugin's startup stopped before its interface, task manager and currency list were built - the plugin appeared to do nothing. Both windows now open normally every session.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.3.1.5 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v1.3.1.4 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.3.1.3 (2026-10-17) [testing]
- The configuration wizard's auto-open step now sets the actual auto-open setting instead of toggling the sellables table.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
